scripts.check: npm run check:docs && npm run check:constitution && npm run check:story-language && npm run check:host-files && npm run check:story-isolation && biome check --error-on-warnings . && npm run check:types && npm run check:examples && npm run check:workbench && npm run check:design-system && npm run check:integrations
